description: IRVE SYDER is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Irve SYDER. Dataset on the charging infrastructure for electric vehicles (IRVE) of SYDER (Rhône) in CSV format, in accordance with the national public data scheme. This file details the network of terminals open to the public, including their geographic location (GPS), their maximum power, the types of sockets available and their operating status. Supervised by Qovoltis. Coverage: Irve SYDER. The publisher named on the listing is Irve SYDER. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
